name: garmin-mcp
description: Connect Claude to Garmin activities, health, workouts, cycling analysis, and preview-first coaching tools.
long_description:
This MCP server bridges Claude to your personal Garmin Connect data via the garminconnect Python library.

**Capabilities:**
- Activities: list, detail, pause-aware streams, splits, laps, heart-rate zones, weather
- Health: steps, sleep, stress, body battery, HRV, SpO2, respiration
- Training: readiness, load trends (CTL/ATL/TSB), VO2 max trend, power zones
- Analysis: decoupling, historical zone re-slicing, polarization, FIT analysis, Power Duration Curve
- Workouts: preview-first cycling builders, upload, schedule, download, bulk operations
- Optional local physiology evidence and deterministic cycling plans/adaptations
- Body, gear, badges, challenges, and nutrition logging

**First-time setup:** Authenticate once by running `garmin-mcp-auth` in a terminal (see README). Passwords and MFA are not requested through MCP form elicitation.

token_path.title: Token storage directory
token_path.description: Directory where your Garmin OAuth tokens are stored. You must run garmin-mcp-auth once in a terminal to generate these tokens before using the server.
